name: What should I do first if my home layout feels awkward or wasteful?

mainEntity.name: What should I do first if my home layout feels awkward or wasteful?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first step is to identify what is not working: traffic flow, storage, room size, privacy, light, or how the space supports your routine. From there, a layout plan can evaluate whether walls, doorways, or room boundaries should change to create a better arrangement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start by listing the friction points in your current layout, then have the existing space reviewed before making design decisions.
